verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference runtime: it streams MoE weights from SSD, uses LoRA adapters, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. User-configurable autonomous background automations belong to agent or workflow products, not model-serving engines. The macOS 'daemon' mention refers to a background serving process, not automations a user can set up, so the agenticness axis does not apply to this product type.
